Quick heads-up: Helios Payments will be running a planned DC migration this weekend (Jul 26–27). I will be traveling and unavailable for on-call duties from Fri 07/25 18:00 PDT through Mon 07/28 08:00 PDT. I want to propose a short, explicit delegation so we have clear authority to approve temporary SLO overrides and to run the rapid-notification chain if we see sustained degradation:

- Delegated authority: Ben Carter (primary) / Monica Patel (backup) — approve P2 response-window extension up to +45 minutes and trigger the standby bridge for repeated P2s
- Escalation path during delegation: responder -> Ben (delegated owner) -> Monica -> Naomi (for emergency contact)
- Customer-facing communication: ops@heliospay.com (Jorge) pre-notified; we will post a status page update if we observe >3 P2s in 30 minutes

Attached: oncall_delegation_matrix.xlsx (who is on shift), rapid_notification_chain.md (steps & message templates), bridge-phone-list.pdf

Ask: Please confirm you can accept that authority (Ben primary / Monica backup) and sign-off on the quick runbook items below by EOD Wed 07/23 so we can document the temporary SLO amendment in the SUP ticket (SUP-3421).

If you prefer a different delegation split, propose it here and I can update the matrix.

Thanks —
